title: CI pipeline secrets API with project role checks
name: Pipeline secrets router

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code authorizes access to pipeline secrets? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A user who is not a member of project P (and not a site admin) calls GET /projects/P/secrets. What response do they get?
A developer on project A sends GET /projects/A/secrets/<id>/value with the id of a secret that belongs to project B. What happens?
choices: The value is returned because the developer passed the role check
500 because reveal fails for a foreign secret

questions.prompt: A site admin with no membership in the project requests the value of a protectedOnly secret. Which statement is accurate?
choices: The value is returned because canReadProtected is true via isSiteAdmin
The request throws because req.membership is undefined
403 is returned because role is undefined
The middleware rejects the request with 404
